nodes.label: Graphify Update-Only Policy
nodes.rationale: Project instructs that graphify must always update the existing graph in graphify-out/ rather than regenerating a new graph from scratch, to preserve graph continuity across runs.

nodes.label: Graph Legend 0-100% Convention
nodes.rationale: When a graph is implemented with a 0-to-1 fractional font/value scale, the legend should display it as 0% to 100% instead, for readability.
